---- sub folders data 
USE nyc_taxi_discovery;

SELECT
    TOP 100 *
FROM
    OPENROWSET(
        BULK 'trip_data_green_csv/year=2020/month=01/green_tripdata_2020-01.csv',
        DATA_SOURCE = 'nyc_taxi_data_raw',
        FORMAT = 'CSV',
        HEADER_ROW = TRUE,
        PARSER_VERSION = '2.0'
    ) AS trip_data;


----- SELECT DATA FROM folder 
SELECT
    TOP 100 *
FROM
    OPENROWSET(
        BULK 'trip_data_green_csv/year=2020/month=01/*.csv',
        DATA_SOURCE = 'nyc_taxi_data_raw',
        FORMAT = 'CSV',
        HEADER_ROW = TRUE,
        PARSER_VERSION = '2.0'
    ) AS trip_data;

---- SELECT DATA FROM SUBFOLDER 
SELECT
    TOP 100 *
FROM
    OPENROWSET(
        BULK 'trip_data_green_csv/year=2020/**',
        DATA_SOURCE = 'nyc_taxi_data_raw',
        FORMAT = 'CSV',
        HEADER_ROW = TRUE,
        PARSER_VERSION = '2.0'
    ) AS trip_data;

-------GET DATA MORE ONE FILE

SELECT
    TOP 100 *
FROM
    OPENROWSET(
        BULK ('trip_data_green_csv/year=2020/month=01/*.csv',
               'trip_data_green_csv/year=2020/month=02/*.csv'),
        DATA_SOURCE = 'nyc_taxi_data_raw',
        FORMAT = 'CSV',
        HEADER_ROW = TRUE,
        PARSER_VERSION = '2.0'
    ) AS trip_data;
   ---- Use more than 1 Wildcrat character

SELECT
    TOP 100 *
FROM
    OPENROWSET(
        BULK 'trip_data_green_csv/year=*/month=*/*.csv',   
        DATA_SOURCE = 'nyc_taxi_data_raw',
        FORMAT = 'CSV',
        HEADER_ROW = TRUE,
        PARSER_VERSION = '2.0'
    ) AS trip_data;


--- Get meata data function filename()

SELECT top 100
    result.filename() AS file_name,
    result.*
FROM
    OPENROWSET(
        BULK 'trip_data_green_csv/year=*/month=*/*.csv',   
        DATA_SOURCE = 'nyc_taxi_data_raw',
        FORMAT = 'CSV',
        HEADER_ROW = TRUE,
        PARSER_VERSION = '2.0'
    ) AS [result];
 


SELECT top 100
    result.filename() AS file_name,
    COUNT(1) AS record_file
FROM
    OPENROWSET(
        BULK 'trip_data_green_csv/year=*/month=*/*.csv',   
        DATA_SOURCE = 'nyc_taxi_data_raw',
        FORMAT = 'CSV',
        HEADER_ROW = TRUE,
        PARSER_VERSION = '2.0'
    ) AS [result]
GROUP BY result.filename()
ORDER BY result.filename();




----LIMIT DATA USING FILE NAME 
SELECT top 100
    result.filename() AS file_name,
    COUNT(1) AS record_file
FROM
    OPENROWSET(
        BULK 'trip_data_green_csv/year=*/month=*/*.csv',   
        DATA_SOURCE = 'nyc_taxi_data_raw',
        FORMAT = 'CSV',
        HEADER_ROW = TRUE,
        PARSER_VERSION = '2.0'
    ) AS [result]
WHERE  result.filename()  IN ('green_tripdata_2020-01.csv','green_tripdata_2020-02.csv')    
GROUP BY result.filename()
ORDER BY result.filename();


----- USING filepath() function

SELECT top 100
      result.filename() AS file_name,
    result.filepath() AS file_path,
    COUNT(1) AS record_file
FROM
    OPENROWSET(
        BULK 'trip_data_green_csv/year=*/month=*/*.csv',   
        DATA_SOURCE = 'nyc_taxi_data_raw',
        FORMAT = 'CSV',
        HEADER_ROW = TRUE,
        PARSER_VERSION = '2.0'
    ) AS [result]
WHERE  result.filename()  IN ('green_tripdata_2020-01.csv','green_tripdata_2020-02.csv')    
GROUP BY result.filename() , result.filepath()
ORDER BY result.filename() , result.filepath();


---- USING filepath() function and parameter

SELECT top 100
      result.filename() AS file_name,
    result.filepath(1) AS year,
    result.filepath(2) AS month,
    COUNT(1) AS record_file
FROM
    OPENROWSET(
        BULK 'trip_data_green_csv/year=*/month=*/*.csv',   
        DATA_SOURCE = 'nyc_taxi_data_raw',
        FORMAT = 'CSV',
        HEADER_ROW = TRUE,
        PARSER_VERSION = '2.0'
    ) AS [result]
WHERE  result.filename()  IN ('green_tripdata_2020-01.csv','green_tripdata_2020-02.csv')    
GROUP BY result.filename() , result.filepath(1) , result.filepath(2) 
ORDER BY result.filename() , result.filepath(1) , result.filepath(2);



---- EACH OF RECORD COUNT 

SELECT top 100
    result.filepath(1) AS year,
    result.filepath(2) AS month,
    COUNT(1) AS record_file
FROM
    OPENROWSET(
        BULK 'trip_data_green_csv/year=*/month=*/*.csv',   
        DATA_SOURCE = 'nyc_taxi_data_raw',
        FORMAT = 'CSV',
        HEADER_ROW = TRUE,
        PARSER_VERSION = '2.0'
    ) AS [result]  
GROUP BY  result.filepath(1) , result.filepath(2) 
ORDER BY  result.filepath(1) , result.filepath(2);




---- USE filepath in WHERE Clause


--- EACH OF RECORD COUNT 

SELECT top 100
    result.filepath(1) AS year,
    result.filepath(2) AS month,
    COUNT(1) AS record_file
FROM
    OPENROWSET(
        BULK 'trip_data_green_csv/year=*/month=*/*.csv',   
        DATA_SOURCE = 'nyc_taxi_data_raw',
        FORMAT = 'CSV',
        HEADER_ROW = TRUE,
        PARSER_VERSION = '2.0'
    ) AS [result]  
WHERE  result.filepath(1) = '2020'
AND result.filepath(2) IN ('05','06','07')
GROUP BY result.filename() , result.filepath(1) , result.filepath(2) 
ORDER BY result.filename() , result.filepath(1) , result.filepath(2);
